title: A Guiding Light of Fond Devotion

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One week remaining until Mejiro Bright's Debut Selection Race. I had to
bring out more of her running potential before then, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: —And so, allow me to introduce everyone~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
From the left: Dober, with her dignified strength; the proud McQueen-sama;
and my dearest, kindest big sister, Ryan-oneesama~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. Welcome to our tea party!
So, Bright... who is this?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: Yes. This is my Temporary Trainer-sama~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Temporary...?
choice_data_list: I'm supervising her training until the Debut Selection Race...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I see. That is coming up very soon, isn't it?
Receiving focused guidance from a professional is of the utmost importance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So, so, how's training with Bright going?
I know you two just got started, though!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
*pant*... *pant*~... ...All right, here I...!
...Oh, my? I have crossed the finish line again~...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I had observed, her easygoing nature resulted in sluggish starts,
and she struggled with pacing, unable to judge when to accelerate on her own.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
May I run a little more~?
I am still full of energy. Please, give me any instruction you wish~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, her running was by no means lacking. Looking past that first
impression revealed just how long and sustained her late drive could be.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With clear tactical directions on when to make her move, we could cover
her weaknesses. All that remained for victory was—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Temporary Trainer-sama, would you care for some tea~?
Please try adding these stewed apples to it. Here you are~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it~? It warms you up right down to your heart~.
A cup of hot tea is truly a blessing during the cold winter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober was the one who taught me to drink it this way~. She is so dependable
and teaches me so many things... Isn't she wonderful~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
McQueen-sama is terribly kind as well. Whenever I am sunbathing,
she drapes a blanket over me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And above all else, her running form is simply breathtaking~!
Graceful, gorgeous, and ideal. It leaves me utterly enchanted every time.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I know, right?!
McQueen really does have such a beautiful stride~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ufufu~.
I adore your running just as much, Ryan-oneesama.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
So powerful, making the ground rebound with every single stride...
It reflects your strong spirit, and I admire it deeply.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Waaah, you're exaggerating way too much!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am not exaggerating at all.
I truly love and respect all of you from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Everyone in our family, staff included, is truly remarkable.
...Bright might have made a delightful host for our upcoming event.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Yes, we are hosting a talk show event for our fans soon,
gathering the members of the Mejiro family who have already debuted.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober and I haven't debuted yet, so we are merely going to observe~.
Oh, if you would like, please come along with us, Temporary Trainer-sama.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After enjoying tea for a while longer, we all headed back to the academy.
While waiting alone for Mejiro Bright to change for training...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Bright's Trai—er, Temporary Trainer!
Thank you so much for today. I had a great time thanks to you!
choice_data_list: Sorry for barging in on you all so suddenly.
Sorry for barging in on you all so suddenly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Not at all! Bright brought you along, right?
Then I'm sure there's a good reason for it.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
She might seem a bit spacey on the outside, you know?
But deep down, she's got an incredibly strong core.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, yeah! ...I'm really not the kind of person anyone should look up to.
Yet whenever Bright says something... it gives me real confidence.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
So I'm sure she has a solid reason for choosing you, too.
...Please, take good care of her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Speaking of which, we should explain the situation and ask them to wait.
I'm sure they'll understand, though they might get bored in the meantime...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Well, you see...
It's because you paused to gaze at the fallen leaves with me~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. By nature, I seem to be quite the slowpoke~.
Both my thoughts and my growth lag behind everyone else.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Ever since I was little, straight through to this very day...
I have let down so many people who placed their hopes in me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: —As a Mejiro horsegirl, it is truly shameful.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...Even so, I do not believe I am a lost cause.
Though my steps may be leisurely, I too am a daughter of Mejiro.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I entered the Debut Race thinking it was time to prove my strength.
Yet deep down, I knew I could not achieve the results I longed for as I was.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
That was when I met you. Someone who looked up at the sky
at the very same unhurried pace as me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I felt that together, you could help me show the world who I truly am.
Following in the footsteps of Ryan-onesama and the others who have shone so brightly...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: —To become a brand-new light for the Mejiro family...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"To become a brand-new light"... Beneath her languid demeanor
flickered a firm, unyielding resolve. That must be her very reason for running.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And that conviction was the final piece needed for victory.
Belief can propel someone to take that decisive final step. With that in place—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—Haa... haah...!
When I hear your voice, I run faster... When I hear your voice—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
! Right...!
Time to... pick up the pace...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
What I taught her was the precise timing to accelerate. Since it takes time for her
engine to rev up, I give the cue early. And when I do—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haah~...
Provisional Trainer, how was my timing~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I am so glad~. ...Signals are truly wonderful, aren't they?
Knowing just when that moment arrives makes running feel so delightful~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In an actual race, things might not go as smoothly as in practice. But...
she has a reason she cannot lose. That resolve will surely lead to results.
